 Game 11: Vanderbilt Commodores at Florida Gators – Open Game Thread 
 GAINESVILLE, FLORIDA - OCTOBER 18: A general view of Ben Hill Griffin Stadium before the start of a game between the Florida Gators and the Mississippi State Bulldogs on October 18, 2025 in Gainesville, Florida. (Photo by James Gilbert/Getty Images) | Getty Images Thomas Stephenson · SB Nation Sat, November 21, 2026 at 3:30 PM UTC · 1 min read Vanderbilt has two games left to try to salvage something from the 2026 football season. Wins over Florida and Tennessee to close the season would certainly give the 4-6 Commodores something to build on for 2027, or at least that's the kind of thing we used to say in the days before the transfer portal when we could safely assume the underclassmen would all be returning.
 Have fun, expect to win.
